test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

G_KMI_MGK_GIM_IK
solution:
**Given :** G_KMI_MGK_GIM_IK

By checking options :

 
• IIKK → G__**I**__KMI__**I**__MGK__**K**__GIM__**K**__IK → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• MGIK → G__M__KMI__G__MGK__I__GIM__K__IK → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• GGMI → G__G__KMI__G__MGK__M__GIM__I__IK → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• IKMG → G__I__KMI__K__MGK__M__GIM__G__IK → (It follows the pattern of : Shifting in the forward direction subsequently. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/204637da12e8e2be2096cfd61a8ac601d247423a6e9bf713493124854591f471.png] )

⇒Option - (4) gives the pattern of "G__I__KM - I__K__MG - K__M__GI - M__G__IK"

Hence, "**IKMG**" is the correct answer.
